videos.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
videos.description: The Lemmings lay hands on an ancient console, and Grizzy is transported into the game.

videos.title: Duck and Frog
videos.description: Duck and Frog are working at a supermarket alongside Toad and Flamingo, who keep ruining Duck and Frog's hard work to make them look bad. Why are they being so mean?

videos.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
videos.description: Roy, Crocalor, and Kilowattrel take on Drayton in a spirited rematch.

videos.title: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
videos.description: When Vexius launches a devastating attack on Red Fountain, Winx and Specialists must unite to protect the school. Meanwhile, Bloom uncovers a shocking connection between Vexius and her Dragon Flame.

videos.title: The Next Step: Cheer
videos.description: Levi tries to calm nerves, Melody works on a new routine, and Jordan practices her smile.

videos.title: Newsround
videos.description: News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.

videos.title: Blue Peter
videos.description: Lindsey, Richie and Henry the dog welcome a brand-new presenter to 'Blue Peter'. On their first show, the 39th presenter is thrown straight into a dance challenge; former BP stars share their top tips. Plus, find out all about them through a very special animation.

videos.title: Deadly 60
videos.description: Steve Backshall heads to Oman in search of wolves and giant super pods.

videos.title: Gardeners' World
videos.description: At Longmeadow, Monty has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment.

videos.title: Naturewatch
videos.description: The team dives into some intriguing autumn mysteries: why don't seals drown? What is the UK's most deadly mushroom? And what extraordinary creature has the power to keep autumn leaves alive?

videos.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
videos.description: Anita Rani pays a Christmas visit to Baroness Floella Benjamin to reflect on a remarkable life shaped by family, faith and the festive season.

videos.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
videos.description: Marcus plans to bring in some ducks, but things aren't as simple as they seem as he heads out onto the lake to create a new home for them. Heading to Devon, he discovers the perfect breed for the smallholding.

videos.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
videos.description: Nadiya shares her effortless, simple celebratory bakes for every day of the week, making special occasions a whole lot easier. She gets the party started with a playful crowd pleaser inspired by her travels to New Orleans.

videos.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
videos.description: Screen adaptation of Oscar Wilde's comic masterpiece. Set in the 1890s England, a comedy of mistaken identity ensues when two gentlemen friends use the same alias to pursue the women they love.

videos.title: Strangers on a Train
videos.description: Alfred Hitchcock's classic about two men who plot a perfect murder. When tennis pro Guy Haines meets smooth-talking Bruno Antony in the bar car of a train, he finds the stranger sympathetic with his desire to be rid of his clinging wife. The sinister Bruno then proposes that they swap murders: Bruno will murder Guy's wife, and Guy will do away with Bruno's father.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: Charles Hanson and Adam Partridge unearth all manner of items to auction at the Platform in Morecambe in Lancashire, including French porcelain and Japanese carvings. Paul Martin visits the railway station that was the set for the iconic film `Brief Encounter'.

videos.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
videos.description: Bob Harris and Suzi Perry swap music and motors for a Japanese boat and Westwood jewels.

videos.title: The Eagle Has Landed
videos.description: In a daring kidnap attempt, a small force of crack German paratroopers are poised to snatch Winston Churchill and return with him to Germany. If they succeed in their mission, it could alter the course of the war.

videos.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 3
videos.description: A collection of 40 rarely seen musical moments that don't often get to escape from the BBC vaults. Including Roachford, David Bowie, Mary J. Blige and Gloria Estefan.

videos.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 2
videos.description: Another deep dive into the BBC's music archives, where the musical map is pointed away from Top of the Pops on a quest to uncover 40 rarely seen performances and hidden gems.

videos.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC
videos.description: Featuring the BBC's magical music archives, a Top 40 with a difference. In a Top of the Pops-free-zone, these are the surprising songs and rare performances that are not seen every day, taken from shows that may have been forgotten.

videos.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
videos.description: The third leg of the race sees the teams leave behind the jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail.

videos.title: Bill's Included
videos.description: When Bill's wife walks out on him for the gardener, he's left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students.

videos.title: This Is BBC TWO
videos.description: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

videos.title: Countryfile
videos.description: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the fastest animal in the world - the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters, from dolphins off Anglesey to spectacular starling murmurations at Newport Wetlands.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

videos.title: Landward
videos.description: In a special episode from North Sutherland, Dougie steps out into the Flow Country. Arlene catches up with Joyce Campbell to see her switch from sheep to regenerative farming.

videos.title: Beechgrove Garden
videos.description: Indonesian cook and gardener Dina Watt goes from garden fork to table fork. Dina grows to cook in her Banchory garden, creating tasty and innovative dishes with her homegrown produce and adding an Indonesian twist to her Scottish-grown crops.

videos.title: A Cook Abroad
videos.description: Scottish chef Tony Singh travels to India, the country of his ancestors, to trace his family roots and discover whether his mum's Punjabi cooking is the real deal. He begins his journey in Amritsar before braving the Grand Trunk Road to Delhi.

videos.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
videos.description: Eva charts the history of French cuisine via a seven-course fine dining meal aboard a Seine riverboat.

videos.title: The Man Who Never Was
videos.description: Espionage story of a British intelligence officer who plans an elaborate hoax in the spring of 1943 to fool the Germans into thinking the Allies are about to invade Greece, not Sicily. The plan calls for the navy to float a dead body carrying false identification and information so that the Germans will pick it up. The first part of the mission succeeds, but will the Nazis take the bait?

videos.title: Homes Under the Hammer
videos.description: In Scotland, Martel encounters a house with a safety order attached, meaning certain rooms cannot be accessed. Meanwhile, in south Wales, Owain views a sizeable unit with significant development potential.

videos.title: Live: WSL
videos.description: Coverage of the Women's Super League clash between Arsenal and West Ham United.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: Paul Martin is joined by experts Michael Baggott and Claire Rawle at Longleat in Wiltshire. Claire makes a momentous discovery of Tibetan artefacts belonging to a collection of controversial historical significance, which all end up under the hammer.

videos.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
videos.description: In the fourth leg, the teams enter a new frontier, Australia. The sixth-largest country on the planet and home to eight distinct climate zones, it's a land of extreme contrasts.

videos.title: This Farming Life
videos.description: Spring is in the air, bringing newborn livestock. In North Uist, Carianne spends her days on the tiny island of Vallay in search of new Highland calves. When one calf is discovered without a mother, Carianne must turn detective to reunite them.

videos.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
videos.description: Founded by the ancient Celts, Brittany has a rugged, wild character and some fresh seafood.

videos.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
videos.description: Starting at the spectacular Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland, Simon travels down the east coast to the great and rapidly changing cities of Belfast and Dublin. He ends his journey in the stunning Wicklow Mountains.

videos.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
videos.description: Paul and Bob fish two vast loughs in County Tyrone, hoping to lure an elusive pike out of hiding. Bob has a fail-safe method to try, but will he manage to catch one?

videos.title: A Course Called Ireland
videos.description: With brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, Bill reflects on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf helped bind nine siblings together.

videos.title: Uncanny
videos.description: Lindsey and her family experience terrifying events in their new-build house on the Isle of Thanet in Kent. Could the answers lie beneath their feet?

videos.title: Get Out
videos.description: Now that Chris and his girlfriend, Rose, have reached the meet-the-parents milestone of dating, she invites him for a weekend getaway upstate with her parents, Missy and Dean. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behaviour as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries leads him to a truth that he never could have imagined.

videos.title: Blue Velvet
videos.description: When Jeffrey Beaumont discovers a severed ear in a field, his curiosity leads him into the world of extreme violence and weird sex controlled by Frank Booth, a criminal totally out of control, and Dorothy Vallens, a damsel in distress who seems to be in his thrall - or is she?

videos.title: Question Time
videos.description: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Worthing. On the panel are David Lammy, Joe Robertson, Adrian Ramsay, Alex Depledge and Fraser Nelson.

videos.title: Honey
videos.description: Martha is annoyed after Kurt steals their joint credit for locating Kamilla, and she vows to gain access to the scientist alone. A competitive Kurt promises to do the same. Friedrich is ordered by his boss Schimmel to ramp up his efforts to locate Greta, believing she is the key to the Hermann Metzl case. Eager for a win, Martha and Kurt attempt to insinuate their way into Friedrich's confidence to find Greta. Stung by his reaction, Martha steals a prized possession.

videos.title: This Is BBC TWO
videos.description: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

videos.title: Bargain Hunt
videos.description: Anita Manning presents as the hunt for bargains heads to Southwell Racecourse. Antiques experts Mark Stacey and Raj Bisram are on hand to help out the teams.

videos.title: Blue Planet III
videos.description: A look at the surprising connections between the world's oceans, from the icy worlds of the poles to unexpected coasts closer to home.

videos.title: Match of the Day
videos.description: Highlights from the 2026/27 Premier League season.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

videos.title: Politics Live
videos.description: Engaging conversation about the political issues that matter to you.

videos.title: Impossible
videos.description: Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.

videos.title: Bridge of Lies
videos.description: A team of family and friends, Amy, JP, Nic and Alan, take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category.

videos.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
videos.description: Colin Murray discovers a brown sauce revival and the advantages of getting fish from a fishmonger as he visits Derry/Londonderry's Walled City Market. Briony-May Williams explores how Somerset is rivalling France in cheese production, and Onkar Singh Purewal discovers the secrets of beekeeping. Chef Julie Lin is in Dundee finding out how bakers keep up with demand around the clock.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael starts a new railway journey in Newcastle, heading north to Berwick-upon-Tweed. His route takes in the River Tyne, Hadrian's Wall, a former mining village and the fishing port of Amble.

videos.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
videos.description: As Storm Arwen hits UK waters, Victory Rose decides when to take shelter from the storm. Crabber Siwrengale has three days to make a week's wages, and Revival goes in search of North Sea prawns.

videos.title: Antiques Roadshow
videos.description: Michael Aspel and the team return to Coughton Court in Warwickshire, where the experts get excited about an Agatha Christie letter, a medal awarded to those who came to the aid of the Titanic survivors and a rare china figure of the Queen on horseback.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: Paul Martin is joined by experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon in Oxford Union to pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at auction.

videos.title: House of Games
videos.description: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

videos.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
videos.description: Ellie Taylor kicks off the week with an exclusive chat with the latest couple to bow out from Strictly. Also, Friday's all-star panel return to break down the weekend action from the Tower Ballroom.

videos.title: Global Eye
videos.description: Bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories.

videos.title: Mastermind
videos.description: Clive Myrie hosts, and contenders answer questions on specialist subjects including Marilyn Monroe, Katherine Mansfield and The Sopranos.

videos.title: Only Connect
videos.description: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far. It's another rematch, where the teams know each other from before but can't afford to drop their guard.

videos.title: University Challenge
videos.description: In another second-round match, the team from Bristol take on their neighbours on the Avon at the University of Bath for a place in the quarter-finals. Amol Rajan asks the questions.

videos.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
videos.description: Unlocking the dark secrets, hidden doors and secret messages of Venice's Doge's Palace, including a torture chamber and 24-carat gold staircase.

videos.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
videos.description: Lee and Sarah are in Portadown where a man takes a strong dislike to Stephen. Later, an aggressive suspect kicks off, all the way to custody.

videos.title: Newsnight
videos.description: Featuring extensive coverage of the day's top national and international news stories, along with explanations about the context and potential aftereffects.

videos.title: Blood
videos.description: Sibling detectives investigate the fatal stabbing of a 12-year-old girl.

videos.title: Highland Cops
videos.description: Police investigate the disappearance of a young monk from a monastery on a remote private island in Orkney. The mystery deepens when there appears to be no evidence of how he could have left the island.

videos.title: Countryfile
videos.description: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the fastest animal in the world - the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters, from dolphins off Anglesey to spectacular starling murmurations at Newport Wetlands.

videos.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
videos.description: Marco, Gordon and Heston reunite for the first time in decades. Will time have healed old wounds, or will old rivalries still burn brightly?

videos.title: This Is BBC TWO
videos.description: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

videos.title: Bargain Hunt
videos.description: Tim Wonnacott presents the antiques programme in which teams of amateur collectors are challenged to root out bargains at antique fairs and sell them for a profit at auction.

videos.title: The Finish Line
videos.description: Roman Kemp, with sidekick Sarah Greene, hosts the quiz show where knowledge equals speed. Amanda, Jamie, Iain, Namita and Chris race in moving podiums across the studio to try to win £5,000.

videos.title: Clive Myrie's Caribbean Adventure
videos.description: Clive visits the bustling district of Vedado, the most modern and affluent part of Havana. He takes a motorcycle tour with Ernesto Guevara, Che Guevara's son, and finds out how to create an amazing feast even though Cubans live under rationing.

videos.title: Only Connect
videos.description: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far - the vital extra ingredients are logic and lateral thinking. Three fans of a paranoid android take on a team of Merseysiders - only one team can progress to the next round, and they get there by connecting clues such as lop, urve, cheron, and actrian camel humps.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

videos.title: Politics Live
videos.description: Engaging conversation about the political issues that matter to you.

videos.title: Impossible
videos.description: Following one lucky and smart finalist who might unleash a torrent of coins.

videos.title: Bridge of Lies
videos.description: A team of family and friends, Leanne, Jenny, Louise and Lauralee, take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they must cross the Bridge, stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies.

videos.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
videos.description: Edith Bowman and Colin Murray explore the Nairn Show to find tips and treats among the food stalls, including how to spot the perfect egg and how to choose the juiciest berries. Baker Briony-May Williams discovers bargains when using an app designed to reduce food waste. Farmer Meinir Howells gets to grips with turning rapeseed into oil in Rhuthin, and chef Suzie Lee finds out whether there's such a thing as a healthy bacon sandwich.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo continues his journey exploring England's north-east coast. Heading north from Newcastle, he discovers one of Newcastle's trendiest hotspots, Ouseburn, and is intrigued to hear of its part in Newcastle's early industrial development.

videos.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
videos.description: Liz Bonnin heads to the Dominican Republic, where she scales a palm tree, searches for a solenodon, joins local scientists in the driest and lowest place in the Caribbean, and helps a heroic team liberate flamingos after over 20 years of captivity.

videos.title: Antiques Roadshow
videos.description: Michael Aspel and the team visit Sydney in Australia. The journey is well rewarded as thousands of fans turn out with a remarkable array of treasures. Amongst the items are pieces of furniture made by convicts transported to Australia, a part of the keel of Captain Cook's ship Endeavour, and a collector of items belonging to opera star Maria Callas receives one of the biggest valuations in Roadshow history.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: Paul Martin and the `Flog It!' team head to Ashridge House in Hertfordshire, an impressive estate which used to be home to Queen Elizabeth I. Claire Rawle and Thomas Plant join Paul in the hunt for unwanted antiques. Claire is surprised by a Susie Cooper charger with a very unusual design, and Thomas sets his sights on a Royal Worcester coffee set in pristine condition.

videos.title: House of Games
videos.description: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

videos.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
videos.description: Ellie Taylor is back with more backstage gossip and behind-the-scenes action from the world of Strictly as she talks to some of the couples. Also, Anton Du Beke swings by for a chat about all things Blackpool.

videos.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
videos.description: The Bikers continue their journey by heading to North West Wales, a remote but beautiful part of the UK. Alongside epic scenery, the Bikers discover a host of inspiring local producers that are celebrating the area's rich diversity.

videos.title: Highland Cops
videos.description: Police on Skye hunt a suspect after a shocking attack on a barman is caught on CCTV.

videos.title: QI XL
videos.description: Sandi Toksvig is joined by Alex Brooker, Bella Hull, Jamali Maddix and Alan Davies for an X-rated episode of QI.

videos.title: Pointless Celebrities
videos.description: The four teams of celebrities aiming to lift the Pointless trophy include Kéllé Bryan, Kimberly Wyatt, Shazia Mirza, Thanyia Moore, Ollie Proudlock, Caspar Lee, Louisa Lytton and Danielle Harold.
